Hi Daniel and Bob,

To test 2.5.0 with Julia’s Stan.jl I did:

cd ~/Projects/Stan
Renamed  cmdstan  to cmdstan-2.4.0 (to have a backup copy is ever needed).

git clone https://github.com/stan-dev/cmdstan.git
cd cmdstan
make stan-update
make build

Worked flawlessly.
